pages.text: Altered from $(5)Sharpness$(), $(4)Velocity$() increases the attacking speed. Maximum level is $(4)V$() and it conflicts with $(5)Sharpness$(), $(5)Smite$(), $(5)Bane of Arthropods$(), $(4)Heavenfall$() and $(4)Xenophobia$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Even though Velocity uses up the space of the damage increasing enchantments, it can still result in a higher overall output than using for example Smite on an undead. Since the attack speed increase is flat, the slower a weapon is originally, the larger the relative boost will be. Therefore, it can allow even twice as many attacks when used on the slowest ones.
